preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the path length k must satisfy 2 ≤ k < n ≤ 1000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors c must be at least 1, and the number of edge colors must be exactly n(n-1)/2.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in edge_colors)
postconditions.description: Each edge color must be an integer between 1 and c inclusive.
The number of distinct colors used must be exactly c.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(edge_colors[i:j])) >= 2 for i in range(n * (n - 1) // 2) for j in range(i + k, n * (n - 1) // 2 + 1))
postconditions.description: For every path of length k or longer, there must be at least 2 distinct colors among the edges in the path.
